claims.claim: For Controllers, attach the selected output-cache policy through controller or action metadata.
claims.trigger: A selected output-cache policy is applied to Controllers
claims.exceptions: Conditional on using Controller output caching; does not mandate caching or example expiration values.
claims.enforcement_effect: Procedural configuration requirement; no hook enforcement

baseline_comparisons.reason: Dismissed as Controller technique with no outcome restriction.
API placement, safe isolation and justified cache selection do not independently require endpoint metadata attachment.

claims.comparison_reason: Explicit conditional action changes whether the chosen policy is associated with the Controller endpoint. No equivalent atomic action in the three runs.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Define a policy and register output-cache middleware but never attach the chosen policy to the target Controller/action; isolated cache design alone does not satisfy this instruction.

claims.claim: Do not use keyed services when a single registration or a simple explicit factory is clearer.
claims.trigger: Comparing keyed services against simpler registration/factory alternatives
claims.exceptions: Keyed services remain permitted for multiple implementations selected by a known key when the simpler alternative is not clearer.
claims.enforcement_effect: Qualitative choice restriction, no executable enforcement

baseline_comparisons.reason: Registers key-selected implementations but omits the independent clearer-single-registration/factory exclusion.
Actual composition need/general simplicity and explicit registration preference do not reproduce this narrower negative gate for keyed services.

claims.comparison_reason: Known-key multiplicity and actual need can both hold while an explicit factory remains clearer. General simplicity is related but not identical trigger and strength.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Two implementations have known keys and solve a current problem, but a small explicit factory communicates selection more clearly; known-key criterion alone permits what this negative clause rejects.
